steg.tekst: You find out whether it is an hourly rate, an estimate or a fixed price, and you agree on a time.

steg.tekst: Eirik turns up when agreed, tidies up after himself and gives you documentation of the work.

omEirik.tekst: Kobber og Kran is a small plumbing firm in Hemnes, owned and run by Eirik, who is also the plumber. When you call, you talk to Eirik, and he is the one who comes. He knows the village, the wells, the cabins and the winters here, and wants to be the one you call next time too.

punkter: FDV documentation (operation and maintenance) for what is installed, for your home records and your insurer
Documentation of the plumbing work in wet rooms, with photos of everything hidden in walls and floors
Before and after photos of the job, if you want them

skjema.merknad: It takes half a minute. Tell us what it is, where the job is and how Eirik can reach you. You can add photos afterwards, and e-mail is optional. Leaking right now? Turn off the water and call instead.

tjeneste.sideboksTekst: Call Eirik, write on WhatsApp, or send a request with a photo. If water is leaking now, turn off the main stopcock first.
tjeneste.andreTittel: Other things Eirik can help with

priser.mvaNote: All prices include 25% VAT. Businesses get an invoice with VAT shown separately.

prosess.tekst: Send photos of the bathroom as it is today, rough measurements and what you would like. If you live in a housing co-operative, check with the board early.
Eirik looks at the bathroom, the pipes and the drain, and what it takes to make the room watertight and up to current standards.
You get a written offer for the plumbing, as a fixed price or an estimate, stating who does what if an electrician and a tiler are involved.
You agree on a start date and the order of work. Eirik coordinates with the other tradespeople, so you don't have to be the project manager.
The pipes go in, the membrane and drain are checked, and everything that will be hidden is photographed before the walls are closed.
The fittings are installed and tested. You get FDV documentation and documentation of the plumbing work in the wet room.

bad.ansvar: When an electrician and a tiler work through Kobber og Kran, your agreement is with Eirik. You have one person to call and one person to deal with if something is not as agreed. If you bring your own tradespeople, you agree in writing who is responsible for what before work starts.

punkter: Turn off the main stopcock. It is usually where the water comes into the house: in the cellar, the utility room, under the kitchen sink or by the water heater. If you have a well, you can also switch off the pump.
Switch off the power to the water heater at the fuse box if the tank is leaking or the water is turned off.
Mop up what you can, and take photos of the damage and of what is leaking.
Report it to your insurer. Most have their own emergency service that can come and dry things out.
lekkerNaa.ingenDognvakt: Eirik takes urgent jobs when he can, but Kobber og Kran does not have a 24-hour emergency service. If he can't answer, your insurer's emergency service is the quickest help.
